fact: The second-brightest gem of the Southern Cross, blazing hot blue.
bio: Mimosa (Beta Crucis), also known as Becrux, is a hot blue giant roughly 280 light-years away and one of the hottest bright stars visible to the eye. It pulsates subtly and lies within the striking figure of the Southern Cross.
cultural: As a principal star of Crux, Mimosa shares in the Cross's prominence on southern flags and in southern-hemisphere navigation and myth, from Aboriginal Australian sky-stories to Andean cosmology.
